description: Ministry of Public Administration & Management - Notify the Revision No. 4 of Sri Lanka Engineering Service Minute
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns revisions to the Sri Lanka Engineering Service Minute, specifically detailing promotion criteria, qualifications, and service conditions for engineering officers. It is issued by the Public Service Commission and deals with public sector service administration, including promotion timelines, qualification requirements, and disciplinary conditions, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8).
